limitations: The measurements came from generated SQLite demo traffic, not an incident in a production connection pool.
The sample stream continued in the same session, but contiguous history temporarily fell to nine during generation before recovering to 600. Continuous 100 ms sampling is not established by this run.

The six waiting requests and peak of 94 agree with the readings disclosure. The model reported an unknown cause and recommended gathering arrivals and connection hold time; it did not establish a cause or explicitly rank every symptom.

The timing values are observations from the native UI, not the model's exact first-token or completion timestamps. Sample comparisons use the common stream session because the Mac and board wall clocks differed.
The native UI showed the forecast profile but did not expose the underlying integer scores; the forecast's accuracy was not independently established by this run.
